purpose: One-off bounded PMXT selected-source staging before NT catalog projection proof.

performance_evidence.finding: Historical 2026-06-08 artifact evidence: the selected-source slicer scanned only the asset column to locate matching row groups, then projected full columns for 1 of 62 row groups. Current code has since removed the asset-column rescan and requires selector-carried source_row_groups.

current_code_reconciliation.finding: The listed /private/tmp selected-source and selector artifacts predate the current selector schema because selected_assets omit source_row_groups. Current selected_source_slice validates selector.selected_assets[].source_row_groups against Parquet metadata and projects those row groups directly; it no longer scans the asset column to discover row groups.

claim_limits: This artifact does not prove PMXT raw-row-to-NT projection.
This artifact does not prove NT ParquetDataCatalog read-back.
This artifact does not prove BacktestNode consumption of a PMXT source-backed catalog.
This artifact must not be used as evidence that broad PMXT backfill is efficient.

The concrete /private/tmp selected-source artifact is historical under current code and must be regenerated from a selector report containing source_row_groups before citation as current selected-source evidence.
